claims.claim: MYR's Q2 2026 backlog reached a record $3.16B as management cited continued electrical-infrastructure investment and sustained demand across T&D and C&I markets.

factors.name: Grid and electrification buildout
factors.basis: Record backlog and demand across transmission/distribution and commercial-industrial electrical work indicate durable infrastructure workload.

risks.risk: Fixed-price project mix exposes margins to estimation and execution errors.

causalEdges.mechanism: new and upgraded power infrastructure requires specialized construction capacity
causalEdges.falsifier: backlog declines despite continued announced infrastructure spending

unknowns.unknown: Backlog duration and customer concentration are not quantified in this artifact.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 revenue reached a record $1.08B, net income $49.9M and EBITDA $85.0M; gross margin improved to 13.2% from 11.5%, aided by favorable estimate changes, productivity and closeouts.

factors.name: Operating execution
factors.basis: Revenue, earnings, EBITDA and backlog reached records while gross margin expanded.

risks.risk: A portion of margin improvement came from changes in estimated project gross profit and favorable closeouts, which may not recur.

causalEdges.from: higher project volume and favorable execution
causalEdges.mechanism: revenue scale plus productivity/estimate improvements expand gross profit

contradictions.claim: Record profitability is partly supported by favorable project estimate changes, so normalized margin durability remains to be tested.

unknowns.unknown: Normalized margin excluding estimate changes is not asserted here.
